infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DineOpen uses your camera to scan QR codes for table orders, capture menu item photos, and scan supplier invoices for inventory management.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DineOpen accesses your photo library to upload menu item images, restaurant logos, and supplier invoice photos for inventory tracking.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DineOpen uses the microphone for voice-based order taking, allowing staff to speak orders instead of typing them.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: DineOpen uses speech recognition to convert spoken orders into text for faster order entry.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DineOpen uses your location to verify attendance clock-in/out at your workplace.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: DineOpen tracks your location during active deliveries so the restaurant owner can monitor delivery progress.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: DineOpen uses Bluetooth to connect to thermal receipt printers for silent auto-printing of bills and tokens.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: DineOpen uses Bluetooth to connect to thermal receipt printers.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: DineOpen connects to your restaurant's local server on this Wi-Fi so the app keeps working (orders, tables, KOT printing) with no internet.
